repo.description:
### Impact
During the SST the donor node is interpolating parameters that the joiner sent into the command line. Not all parameters were properly validated which could allow a malicious joiner to execute arbitrary shell commands on the donor side via the **rsync** SST method.

### Patches
Fixed in 10.6.27, 10.11.18, 11.4.12, 11.8.8, 12.3.2.

### Workarounds
Removing vulnerable `wsrep_sst_rsync` script from the donor host would prevent rsync SST method from being used.

### References
https://jira.mariadb.org/browse/MDEV-39648
repo.summary: wsrep SST unsafe parameter handling on the donor side (rsync)
